name: scheduler-create
description: Create a scheduled job. Supports cron expressions for recurring jobs and ISO 8601 timestamps for one-shot jobs. Provide intent_anchor to create a persistent multi-burst task.

inputs.error_budget: object? (resumable task config only: resumable, max_stalls, max_iterations, max_wallclock_hours, max_cost_usd — not per-invocation turn limits)
inputs.timezone: string? (IANA timezone name, e.g. America/Toronto — overrides Curia's default timezone for this job's cron schedule)
